title: NASCAR Cup Series Championship Watch Party
shortDescription: Watch the NASCAR Cup Series Championship with other fans at Boze's. Race broadcast begins at 3 PM on NBC.
description: The NASCAR Cup Series championship comes down to one final race. Watch the season finale from Homestead-Miami Speedway with Four Dogs at Boze's Restaurant & Bar in West Columbia on Sunday, November 8. The NBC race broadcast begins at 3 PM Eastern. We'll mix in quick NASCAR trivia during stage breaks so you can test your knowledge while you watch. Come for the racing, the conversation, and a great afternoon together.

admission.note: Free admission. Food and drinks sold separately.

instructions: The race broadcast is scheduled for 3:00 PM Eastern on NBC. Join us at Boze's for the watch party; food and drinks are purchased separately. Check back for updates if the broadcast schedule changes.
